entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • MapStaticAssets: builder conventions (e.g. RequireAuthorization) are not applied to the runtime fallback endpoint #69754
  • FormFeature.ReadFormAsync can return a null Task when the body completes on another thread (NullReferenceException in OpenIdConnectHandler) #69744
  • The new IISHostLifetime implementation introduced with .NET 10 isn't logging Microsoft.Hosting.Lifetime events #69739
  • Nested wildcard host endpoint is incorrectly selected for a broader host match #69737

Closed

  • Consider adding an event to the OAuth 2.0 base handler to validate token responses #23749
    Backlog
  • Offer a built-in JWKS endpoint to support encrypted tokens #4683
    Backlog
